mandatoryCriteria: Mounted upload must reject header-only/truncated PNG/JPEG/WebP and structurally malformed declared format, not finalize unusable bytes as a verified saved image.
Real valid images continue to upload/finalize/render; existing MIME/SVG/HTML/hash/size/dimension/count/private delivery safeguards stay effective.
Untrusted chunk/segment lengths and compressed payloads cannot cause unbounded allocation, loops or decompression. All validation dependencies must support Cloudflare Worker and Node runtimes.

Document precisely whether validation includes container integrity or full pixel decoding; do not claim full decoder fidelity from signatures/dimensions. Independent review decides whether residual decoder limits meet feature acceptance.
Preserve pre-repair real mounted reproduction and actual post-repair tests; malformed test fixtures are not valid-image compatibility evidence. No cloud/production/real credentials.
